hints.title: Grid Directed Movement
hints.text: From cell (r, c), you can only transition from (r-1, c) or (r, c-1).

hints.title: Boundary Base Cases
hints.text: The first row accumulates strictly from the left, and the first column accumulates strictly from above.

hints.title: Optimal Subproblem
hints.text: For interior cells, dp[r][c] = grid[r][c] + max(dp[r-1][c], dp[r][c-1]).

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exploring all combination paths takes exponential O(2^(M+N)) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(M * N) space (or O(N) rolling row).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Clean 2D grid DP transition and boundary initialization.
